scannerOnlyReason: The offline reproduce job mounts /tmp and /work as noexec tmpfs and all source read-only, so a freshly compiled Go binary cannot be executed (go run and go test fail); the default job image also has no Go toolchain. Go has no interpreted mode, so the panic cannot be driven in-process the way node and python3 drive the JS and Python oracles. Scanner (OSV) evidence stands on the go.mod version alone.
